title: Building the HTML Coverage Report
description: Run the suite with an HTML coverage report, then open the report in a browser. The report color-codes every line.

steps.description: These commands build the HTML coverage report. The page says the HTML report color-codes every line: green means covered, red means not covered.
`pytest tests/ --cov=. --cov-report=html` runs the suite with coverage over the current directory and writes an HTML report into `htmlcov/`.
The next two lines open `htmlcov/index.html`: `open` on macOS and `xdg-open` on Linux. The page says the colored report makes it easy to spot entire branches of the evaluator that no test exercises.
